title: Canara Mastercard Gold Secured credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The Canara Mastercard Gold Secured credit card from Canara Bank is a fixed-deposit–backed secured card designed to help customers build credit responsibly while enjoying Mastercard network acceptance, basic reward benefits, and global transaction support.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Fraudulent Charge Cover of 5L.|Baggage Insurance upto ₹25K.|Purchase Protection Cover upto ₹25K.|Accident Cover (Air Accident) of 8L for Self and 4L for Spouse.|Accident Cover (Other than Air Accident) of 4L for Self and 2L.
